comment: Which races may be autonomy candidates. This is an ALLOW-list on purpose:
an actor whose race is not listed here is never selected. A missing entry
therefore means 'no scene', never 'a scene with the wrong actor' — the only
acceptable failure direction for the adults-only rule.
Form ids come from AAF's own Data/AAF/AAF_raceData_Fallout4.xml, so this list
cannot drift from what AAF is able to animate. AAF's race list contains no
child race at all; children are excluded by absence here as well as by the

Verified against every raceData file in Data/AAF: AAF knows exactly six human-skeleton races on this setup, and these are them. Anything else it could not animate as a human anyway, so rejecting an unlisted race costs nothing.
